items.title: Import and index product documentation
acceptance_criteria: White paper and engineering blueprint are present.
Architecture, platform, security, developer and roadmap docs are indexed.

items.title: Create Rust workspace and crate scaffold
acceptance_criteria: Cargo workspace declares every app and crate listed in the boundary inventory.
Every member has a manifest and source entrypoint.
No external dependencies are required by the initial scaffold.

items.title: Implement automated TODO, boundary and baseline control
acceptance_criteria: Task dependencies and done-evidence rules are validated.
Cargo workspace membership and dependency edges are inventoried.
Protected baseline structure is verifiable.
Generated reports can be regenerated deterministically.

items.title: Add cross-platform CI and contributor workflow
acceptance_criteria: CI runs repository automation and Rust fmt, Clippy and tests.
Contributor workflow documents the mandatory implementation loop.

items.title: Install and verify supported Rust toolchain in maintainer environments
acceptance_criteria: Rust stable, rustfmt and Clippy are available.
cargo fmt, cargo test and cargo clippy pass on Linux, macOS and Windows CI.

items.title: Finalize domain IDs, digest and target platform model
acceptance_criteria: Target triples are parsed and normalized.
Digest algorithm and encoded value validation is fully specified.
Image references and platform identity have golden and invalid fixtures.

items.title: Define structured diagnostic codes and error policy
acceptance_criteria: Every pipeline failure has a stable code and stage.
Retryability and remediation are explicit.
Secret values and private paths are redacted.

items.title: Implement OCI image reference and descriptor parsing
acceptance_criteria: Registry, repository, tag and digest references are parsed.
OCI descriptor/media-type constraints have positive and negative fixtures.
Manifest, index and config validation is bounded.

items.title: Implement OCI Distribution registry client
acceptance_criteria: Pull pinned manifests and blobs with TLS.
Support credential provider interface without logging secrets.
Support manifest platform selection and retryable network failures.

items.title: Implement bounded blob fetching and digest verification
acceptance_criteria: Blob size and digest are verified before cache promotion.
Downloads are bounded, cancellable and resumable where safe.
Partial downloads are never visible as verified content.

items.title: Build atomic content-addressed layer cache
acceptance_criteria: Cache keys derive from verified digests.
Concurrent writers cannot publish partial objects.
Verify, prune and offline cache commands have tests.

items.title: Implement safe OCI layer decode and extraction
acceptance_criteria: Supported compression formats are explicit.
Path traversal, escaping symlinks, hardlinks and quotas are handled safely.
Whiteout semantics have adversarial fixtures and fuzz targets.

items.title: Reconstruct logical RootFS with OCI layer semantics
acceptance_criteria: Layer order and whiteouts match OCI semantics.
Mode, ownership, links and provenance are preserved.
Golden RootFS fixtures match expected trees.

items.title: Implement image config inspector and NIR v0.1
acceptance_criteria: Entrypoint, command, env, cwd, user, ports, stop signal and healthcheck are normalized.
Unknown required fields are rejected or explicitly preserved.
NIR schema and golden fixtures are versioned.

items.title: Build compatibility analyzer and explicit backend planner
acceptance_criteria: OS, architecture, ABI, kernel and backend requirements are reported.
Unsupported features are never silently dropped.
Backend selection is explainable and policy-driven.

items.title: Integrate Linux OCI runtime backend
acceptance_criteria: Run supported images without Docker Engine.
Rootless mode, namespaces, cgroups, seccomp and capabilities are tested.
No privileged mode is enabled implicitly.

items.title: Implement I2N artifact format and Linux launcher
acceptance_criteria: Manifest and payload graph are versioned.
Artifact integrity is verified before install/run.
Launcher supports install, run, inspect and uninstall lifecycle.

items.title: Add SBOM, provenance and artifact signing
acceptance_criteria: SPDX SBOM scope is documented.
Build provenance binds source digest and toolchain identity.
Signature verification rejects tampered artifacts.

items.title: Harden Linux install, update, rollback and runtime security
acceptance_criteria: Interrupted updates retain last-known-good artifact.
Rollback protection and writable state policy are tested.
Threat-model high-risk findings have mitigations and evidence.

items.title: Build minimal Linux guest and authenticated guest agent
acceptance_criteria: Kernel/init/guest image versions are pinned.
Host-guest protocol is authenticated and versioned.
Guest image is reproducible and integrity checked.

items.title: Implement macOS Virtualization backend and app packaging
acceptance_criteria: Supported Apple Silicon and Intel host matrix is explicit.
Linux guest can boot and run a packaged app.
Signing, entitlements, networking and shared storage are tested.

items.title: Implement Windows WSL2 backend and launcher
acceptance_criteria: WSL2 prerequisites are preflighted and explained.
Guest provision/start/stop and port forwarding are tested.
Windows installer and launcher lifecycle are documented.

items.title: Add Windows-native OCI image backend through HCS
acceptance_criteria: Windows image OS/version compatibility is checked.
Windows container semantics have a separate test matrix.
Linux image backend and Windows image backend remain distinct.

items.title: Add source-to-native compilation mode
acceptance_criteria: Source mode is independent from OCI image packaging.
Rust and Go are initial toolchain integrations.
Output is validated as actual target-native ELF/Mach-O/PE.

items.title: Add supported Docker Compose application groups
acceptance_criteria: Supported Compose subset is versioned.
Service dependencies, networks and volumes are modeled.
Unsupported keys are reported instead of ignored.

items.title: Prepare 1.0 support matrix, release and operations readiness
acceptance_criteria: Every claimed target has real-host integration evidence.
Upgrade/rollback, signing, SBOM and license notices are reviewed.
Release artifacts and compatibility matrix are reproducible.
